Curb use — Hell's Kitchen

What the curb is doing across a week, from NYC DOT parking-sign records placed on blockfaces.
Prototype by Lemon Brown · data: NYC DOT Parking Regulation Locations and Signs (NYC Open Data), DCP LION · blockface geometry derived from LION and curb polygons · built 2026-10-29

The neighborhood, one week

Share of modeled curb length under each rule, by half hour, Monday to Sunday. "Free" means no sign restricts general parking at that time; it says nothing about whether a space is open.

Blockface

Click a blockface on the map. It splits into segments; click a segment to see what applies there and when.
Signed rules only, not observed occupancy. Temporary construction signs excluded. Hydrants, driveways and bike-share docks are not yet subtracted. Distances along a blockface are measured from the cross street DOT uses as the start of the block. Grey faces have no sign record on file.
